description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using the Lightning.js framework. It contains a visual animation of three circles that fade in and out to indicate loading status. The component manages an internal 'alpha' state to control transparency and toggles it periodically in an interval.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A Lightning.js component that displays animated loading circles with fading transition.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins an interval that toggles the alpha transparency of the circles to create a pulsating loading animation.
